ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the distance from the midpoint \(M\) of one side of the rhombus \(ABCD\) to the intersection point \(O\) of the diagonals is \(5 \, \text{cm}\). What is the perimeter of the rhombus \(ABCD\)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus,\\
it follows that $\angle AOB=90^\circ$,\\
since M is the midpoint of side AB,\\
it follows that AB=2OM=10,\\
therefore, the perimeter of rhombus ABCD is $10\times 4=\boxed{40}$.
